job: Read a multi-file TypeScript PR, follow relevant dependencies, return to the exact reading position, explicitly track all remaining changes
priorities: One complete navigator rather than duplicate symbol lists and a competing file rail
Dominant readable code surface with secondary details disclosed on demand
One peek or stable caller/callee panes, no recursive card nesting
Uncertainty signals remain visible where applicable; explanatory paragraphs move behind details
Keyboard and pointer workflows, stable scroll/focus and explicit completion handoff
must_preserve: Full original Git change inventory including metadata/non-code/deleted files
Before/head source links and removed calls
No invented targets, defect verdicts, or review credit from opening source
implementation_notes: Visual options are mockups, not functioning builds
Generated code snippets, paths and counts are illustrative; implementation must use verified report data rather than copy mock text
Inline link positioning must be backed by actual source coordinates; do not guess ambiguous token spans
Performance and human value targets require measurement, not claims

sources.role: Official workflow reference for keyboard interaction and integrated review state
Primary abstract reports repeated-function disorientation and less apparent off-function edits; no efficacy claim for Flow Review

commercial_hypothesis: Reviewers may pay if the tool improves correct behavior understanding and is reused in actual work; willingness to pay is unmeasured
next_action: Observe real reviewer use and measure usefulness before commercial claims
release_architecture: Local analyzer plus static online reader on Vercel
